title: console/subscribe/v1
description: The one client-to-server frame: `{schema, body: {bbox, layers[]}}`, sent on open and whenever the viewport subscription changes; the server answers with a `console/snapshot/v1` (decision record M29, Appendix C; uspace-ui plan §6.3). The client has no receipt or capture times to give, so only `schema` and `body` are required; the server's envelope fields do not apply.

bbox.description: GeoJSON bounding box `[west, south, east, north]` in WGS84 degrees (RFC 7946 §5, 02 §1 `[lng, lat]`). `west > east` crosses the antimeridian.

layers.description: Which snapshot collections to receive (the keys of `console/snapshot/v1`); `alerts` covers `alert/v1` and `violation/v1`.
